scripts.build: yarn build:packs && yarn build:workspaces && yarn build:schema
scripts.build:workspaces: yarn workspace @aws/threat-composer run build && yarn workspace @aws/threat-composer-app run build && yarn workspace @aws/threat-composer-app-browser-extension run build && yarn workspace @aws/threat-composer-infra run build
scripts.e2e:build:extension: yarn e2e:build:variants && yarn workspace @aws/threat-composer-app-browser-extension run compile
scripts.e2e:build:variants: env -u VITE_ROUTE_BASE_PATH -u VITE_GITHUB_PAGES -u PUBLIC_URL yarn workspace @aws/threat-composer-app run compile:browser-extension && env -u VITE_ROUTE_BASE_PATH -u VITE_GITHUB_PAGES -u PUBLIC_URL yarn workspace @aws/threat-composer-app run compile:ide-extension
scripts.eslint: yarn workspaces run eslint && yarn eslint:e2e
scripts.generate:attribution: git secrets --scan && generate-attribution && mv oss-attribution/attribution.txt LICENSE-THIRD-PARTY
scripts.ai:lint: cd packages/threat-composer-ai && uv run ruff check . && uv run ruff format --check .
scripts.ai:test: cd packages/threat-composer-ai && uv run pytest tests/
scripts.postinstall: command -v uv > /dev/null && (cd packages/threat-composer-ai && uv sync) || echo 'uv not found on PATH; skipping packages/threat-composer-ai sync'
scripts.upgrade-deps: yarn npm-check-updates --deep --rejectVersion 0.0.0 -u --dep prod,dev,peer,optional --target=minor && rm -f yarn.lock && yarn install
